desc:
🛒 How much of a supermarket can you eat?

CODE: HALLOWEEN

Turn an ordinary shopping trip into total chaos! Eat your way through the store, earn coins from every calorie, and upgrade your tools to devour even more.

please like the game 

🍔 Eat food and turn calories into coins  
🍴 Upgrade your hands, fork, and vacuum  
💎 Find diamond products to collect gems  
🤝 Hire a noob helper and upgrade his eating skills  
💥 Knock over shelves and send shopping carts rolling  
👥 Team up with friends and clear out the supermarket  

Come hungry. Leave the shelves empty.
